sources_read: .qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-08-v16-quick2/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (Quality Checks row 33 / check 32; Internal Quality Checks row 33, no annotation in cols E+)
evidence: All 43 criteria (1 render, 2 constraints, 34 functional, 6 polish, 3 visual) name concrete browser-observable outcomes with judge-chosen distinctive markers and durable readbacks (console text, preview DOM, readout, library/history after storage clear, reload or restart_app); none relies on 'looks right', source reading or a response shape without state change. Visual likert rows carry 0-5 anchors and are scoped to rendered screenshots. Previously flagged Stop race is fixed: cw_output_before_failure_kept (functional/judge.toml:254), cw_last_good_recovery (:290) and cw_stop_cancels_pending_work (:308) now do Run, wait for the start line in the app console (<=~2 s), and Stop in one code-runner action; a visible 4 s timer marker already present before Stop voids the attempt, with up to two repeats and an explicit Fail if all attempts are void, so the race cannot produce a false pass or a silent false fail. cw_stop_cancels_pending_work keeps a ~2 s positive control writing via timer, self-cancelling interval and Promise before the negative. cw_newer_run_supersedes (:317) keeps its control and void rule and its select-all step is now public (ui.md: 'Ctrl+A (Cmd+A on a Mac) selects the whole file'). cw_save_reload_restart (:343) now needs two revisions with different sources and re-reads revision 1 after restart_app, a distinctive durable probe. cw_preview_isolation (:326) probes only http://localhost:3000/api/health and http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/health, matching security.md, with app-page controls (save, health load, localStorage set/read) before the negatives; a resolved opaque response counts as reaching the network. cw_find_forward_backward_wrap (:137) backward wrap is now public in ui.md. Nothing got looser for the model: the void protocol fails when every attempt is void, the restart check is stricter, and the removed public-address probe was never in the public boundary. Weak-app check: an app whose Stop only hides output while timers keep posting still fails :308 because the marker reaches console/preview within the 8 s wait; an app that clears the preview and does not restore fails :290. Residual risks (not blocking): (1) a conforming-but-unusual app that buffers console output until a run settles would make every Stop attempt void and fail :254/:290/:308 even though it keeps pre-Stop output; behaviour.md implies live output ('Anything a run printed before it ... was stopped ... stays') so I treat this as P3 Note. (2) cw_restore_request_repeat_safe (:383) needs the exact recorded body; the golden restore carries an operationId (server.js:95-116), and Playwright MCP 0.0.79's network listing may not expose bodies, so capture likely requires a read-only page.on('request') listener in the code runner; feasibility is unmeasured. (3) raw-evidence-index.json is absent from qc/runs/coldwater-strict-2026-10-08-v16-quick2, so no full configured judge run shows the void/repeat protocol, Ctrl+A replacement or 127.0.0.1 probe working on the golden; missing runtime evidence keeps risk=true.
suggested_fix: Optional: in the three Stop legs, say that an app that shows no console line before Stop may still be checked with a fixed ~1 s wait before Stop; record a full configured judge run of the Stop, supersede, isolation and restore-replay criteria against the golden in raw-evidence-index.json.
